description_en: This API retrieves a list of RDS AI application instances
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS AI应用实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun rdsai describe-app-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pgm-2ze49qv594vi0000 --app-type supabase --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAppInstances

parameters.description_en: The ID of an RDS PostgreSQL instance to return only the associated AI application instances.
parameters.description_zh: AI应用接入的RDS PostgreSQL数据库实例ID。传入该参数后查询指定RDS PostgreSQL实例关联的AI应用实例。
parameters.help_en: The ID of an RDS PostgreSQL instance to return only the associated AI application instances
parameters.help_zh: AI应用接入的RDS PostgreSQL数据库实例ID。传入该参数后查询指定RDS PostgreSQL实例关联的AI应用实例
parameters.name: db_instance_name

parameters.description_en: The application type. The only supported value is **supabase**, which indicates [RDS Supabase](~~2938735~~).
parameters.description_zh: 应用类型。当前仅支持**supabase**，表示[RDS Supabase](~~2938735~~)。
parameters.help_en: The application type. The only supported value is **supabase**, which indicates https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2938735.html
parameters.name: app_type

parameters.description_en: The number of AI application instances to return on each page. Valid values: **1 to 50**.
parameters.help_en: The number of AI application instances to return on each page. Valid values: **1 to 50**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: The page number of the results to return. The value must be greater than 0.
parameters.description_zh: 页码。取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。
parameters.help_en: The page number of the results to return. The value must be greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 页码。取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值
parameters.name: page_number
